gamerule.agrarian_reform.hydration_sourc: The distance (in blocks) a water source block provides basic hydration to nearby farmland. Default: 8.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.hydration_flowi: The distance (in blocks) that flowing water provides hydration. Default: 4.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.total_trample_i: When enabled, crops and farmland are completely immune to trample damage from players and entities. Default: false.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.growth_biodiver: When enabled, crops get a growth speed bonus when planted near different crop types. Default: true.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.rain_growth_acc: The number of extra growth stages a crop receives per random tick during rain. Default: 1.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.ambient_vitalit: When enabled, healthy growing crops emit subtle 'vitality' particles. Default: true.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.ambient_crop_ru: When enabled, crops produce ambient rustling sounds when they grow or are interacted with. Default: true.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.always_wet_farm: When enabled, farmland remains hydrated regardless of water proximity. Default: false.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.seeds_grow_gras: When enabled, right-clicking a dirt block with agricultural seeds will consume the seed and convert the block to grass. Default: true.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.right_click_har: When enabled, right-clicking a mature crop will harvest its drops, replant it at age 0, and drop the surplus items. Default: true.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.universal_bonem: When enabled, bone meal can be used to accelerate the growth of non-natively bonemealable plants. Default: true.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.global_growth_m: Global speed multiplier for plant growth ticks (0 = disabled, 100 = vanilla, >100 = accelerated). WARNING: Values excessively high (e.g., >1000) will cause massive server lag or watchdog crashes. Use at your own risk. Default: 100.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.pure_water_hydr: When enabled, waterlogged blocks and non-water fluids will not hydrate farmland, only pure water blocks. Default: false.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.trample_immunit: When enabled along with Total Trample Immunity, only players and tamed pets receive trample protection, while hostile/wild mobs still trample farmland. Default: false.
gamerule.agrarian_reform.debug_mode.desc: Enables verbose diagnostic logging in server logs for crop ticks and continuum catch-up. Transient: auto-resets to false on restart. Default: false.
config.agrarian_reform.title: Agrarian Reform Config
config.agrarian_reform.warning: ⚠️ Note: Changing these options only sets the default values for NEW worlds. To change settings for existing worlds, use the in-game GameRules screen or /gamerule command.
config.agrarian_reform.category.crops.de: Individual crop growth speed overrides. Set to 0 to inherit global multiplier, -1 to freeze/disable.
